package.name: easyfleet_fake_collaboration_deployment
package.description: The "collaboration" deployment scenario: three robots working together (robot_1 and robot_2 each carry navigation + perception, robot_3 carries navigation + manipulation) out of fake/mock capabilities (reference implementations of the easyfleet_core NavigationActionServerBase / ManipulationActionServerBase / PerceptionActionServerBase classes), each robot's capabilities hosted together in one process (robot_node) -- kept separate from the example mission control program (collaboration_mission_node, built on easyfleet_mission_manager), which only ever talks to them over their ROS actions. Also ships the launch files and JSON/parameter configuration each is started with.
